deepdive.sec: Solar PV Manufacturing (integrated module → cell → ingot/wafer → polysilicon) + Energy Transition Platform

bull_bear.body: - ~Rs. 1,000 cr equity raised for BESS. Heavy reinvestment across the full value chain ("Waaree 2.0"). Prudent working-capital posture (advances/full-payment-before-ship). No dividend discussion on call.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- US anti-dumping / circumvention investigation (Indonesia/Laos routing) — Rs.294 cr provision booked pre-emptively; outcome unresolved.
- Commodity risk: silver & cell-price inflation (China cells ¢4–4.5 → ~¢6/Wp).
- Cell utilization optics (quarter-avg 56% vs daily 80%) — execution to be proven next quarter.
- Tariff regime "continuously evolving"; reliant on cell country-of-origin rules.
- India PPA logjam (~42 GW stuck) — transmission/transformer/bay/land bottlenecks; demand timing risk.
- New-vertical (BESS/H2/inverter) economics still "embryonic" — no audited numbers.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly promotional, superlative-heavy ("stellar," "record-breaking," "two big dogs"). CEO candid on declining FY27 guidance and on US-investigation provisioning. CFO precise and numbers-fluent. A mid-call audio glitch occurred; mgmt compensated with extra time. Confident, slightly salesy.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The China export-rebate taper (pushing cell prices up ~50%) is framed as a *positive* — it "proves up" Chinese costs and makes Indian supply globally competitive.
- US is the margin engine: ¢28–30/Wp realizations dwarf India's ~Rs.18.5/Wp non-DCR; IRA 45X booked conservatively (90% of ¢7, partial volume) — implies hidden upside / cushion.
- Mgmt is deliberately moving away from quoting GW (mix-driven), signaling EPC/turnkey/non-module revenue is becoming material and harder to benchmark.
- Captive cell consumption + rising DCR is the structural margin story, not spot pricing.
- "Overcapacity is a myth" stance: 9M module/cell demand (35 GW) already exceeds full prior-year; bets demand keeps "galloping."
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Net Debt to Equity of -0.08x as on 30th June 2026 (i.e. net cash), against a historical series of -0.80 (FY23), -0.85 (FY24), -0.72 (FY25) and -0.29 (FY26); the deck also claims a D/E ratio maintained at <1 'despite heavy capex cycles for nearly a decade'.
- Return ratios of ROCE 28.5% and ROE 24.8%, both on trailing-12-month numbers and adjusted for the unutilized portion of IPO proceeds.
- Capital allocation is governed by a stated 'book & build' principle — 'Before commissioning US facility, secured 3+ years of firm orders' and 'Cell capex initiated post long-term orders and policy visibility' — with expansion 'backed by strong order visibility' and described as ROCE and ROE accretive.
- Funding of the ₹31,497 Cr programme is stated to come from strong operating cash flow, customer advances and a significant cash balance, with capital de-risking via central and state subsidies including PLI.
- The certifications slide carries a 'CREDIT RATING UPGRADED TO' header, but the rating itself did not survive extraction (see notes).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **US (Texas):** Q3 ~275 MW produced, ~313 MW sold; US top-line >Rs. 2,000 cr. Meyer Burger HJT assets acquired & ramping. No US cell mfg yet (actively considering). Realizations north of ¢28–30/Wp on some orders (tariff partly passed through).
- **Oman (United Solar Holdings):** non-Chinese fully-traceable polysilicon; production expected to start *this quarter* (Q4 FY26); uptake agreements + financial closure done.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary

| Silver & commodity inflation (silver ~25% of cell cost) | WAAREEENER · 544277 (self) | Non-integrated module assemblers without back-to-back tying | Waaree manages via cell tying, scale, op-leverage, DCR mix; <9% module impact. Med-High |

Med |

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Claims ~26 GW module capacity as the 'Largest Non-Chinese Company in the World' (footnoted 'Courtesy BNEF and Internal Assessment') and 5.4 GW cell capacity as 'India's Largest'; the evolution slide states 25.8 GW aggregate installed module capacity at present versus 22.8 GW in 2025 and 30 MW in 2007.
- Frames the moat as full-stack vertical integration — 'Polysilicon to Ingots & Wafer to Cell to Modules to EPC and O&M' — plus horizontal integration into storage, inverters, transformers and GH2 electrolysers; a peer-comparison slide shows Waaree present across ingot+wafer, cell, module, glass and polysilicon where peers are not.
- Retail is presented as a structural moat: 'India's #1 solar retail brand' (source JMK Research) with '~1 in every 6 Installations' (Module Shipment Q1 CY2026), a channel of 27 states, 200+ districts, 600+ franchises, 2,500+ ASPs, ~15,000 pin codes and 5,000+ MNRE integrators on a loyalty app, with 24-hr order-to-door TAT and a stated aim of expanding to 90% of all Indian pin codes.
- Bankability/quality credentials cited as entry barriers: BNEF Tier-1 for 40 quarters, RETC Highest Achiever, KIWA Top Performer, EcoVadis Gold (Top 5%), ALMM approved, and 'The Only Indian Company with A rating in Product Performance'; TOPCon cell efficiency 25.54% and PERC 23.55%.
- Execution speed claimed as a differentiator: module capacity expanded ~17x to 25.8 GW within 7 years 'ahead of schedule', India cell capacity to grow ~3x to 15.4 GW 'in a record time of ~2 years', and 1.6 GW of greenfield US module capacity built in 12 months.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Guidance] The deck reaffirms FY27 Operating EBITDA guidance of ₹7,000-7,700 Cr.
- [Acquisition] Waaree RTL acquired a ~55% equity stake in Associated Power Structures Pvt. Ltd. (APSPL) for ~₹1,225 crore, adding a T&D arm; APSPL contributes ₹2,700 Cr+ of the ~₹5,300 Cr unexecuted EPC order book and its founders (Satish Desai, Parag Kothari, Ajay Patel) appear in the senior management team.
- [Strategic investment] A strategic stake in United Solar Holding, Oman, gives access to a 100 KTPA polysilicon facility (Advanced Siemens Process, listed as Operational) for 'traceable, non-FEOC Polysilicon'.
- [Policy] Growth is framed against a policy stack: India's PLI, ALMM Lists I-III, 20% BCD on imports, PM Surya Ghar (~US$9bn) and PM-KUSUM; BESS VGF, ISTS waivers, mandatory 2-hour ESS norms and mandatory 100% grid-forming inverters; plus US IRA/UFLPA/Section 232/FEOC and the EU NZIA and Grids Action Plan.
- [New orders] Waaree RTL received a 1,520 MWh BESS EPC order, two ground-mounted solar EPC orders totalling 800 MWac, and signed an ECI agreement for a utility-scale solar PV project integrated with BESS in New Zealand; RE infrastructure has PPAs signed for 1,000+ MW and secured connectivity for developing ~10 GW of solar, wind and BESS projects against a stated ~8 GW pipeline and ₹3,250+ Cr total commitment (including debt/equity/guarantees).
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Gross margin managed via back-to-back cell tying; commodity risk avoided where possible (pass-through is contract-dependent — "sometimes on us").
- Silver impact <9% on a module basis; silver ~25% of cell cost.
- India cell cost of production ~¢7/Wp now (scale benefits to come).
- Realizations: non-DCR module ~Rs.18.5/Wp (India non-DCR ~Rs.14–15; US ~Rs.24–25+); DCR module ~Rs.23–24/Wp.
- Margin levers: rising DCR content, daily utilization gains, operating leverage, price hikes if needed. Mgmt commits to holding/improving margins despite peers (RenewSys/Jackson) flagging need for ~25% price hikes.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- Order book rising toward Rs.60,000 cr (incl. newly disclosed 2.1 GW); pipeline >100 GW.
- Cell production +35% QoQ; daily cell utilization ~80% (from quarter-avg ~56%), targeting 85–90% in 3–4 months via G12R upgrade.
- IRA 45X credit booked ~Rs.80 cr this quarter vs ~Rs.162 cr prior quarter (conservative recognition).
- US realizations escalated to ¢28–30/Wp on some orders (vs prior ¢24–25) on tariff pass-through + mix.
- New: Rs.294 cr exceptional provision for US investigation; ~Rs.1,000 cr equity raised for 20 GWh BESS; Oman polysilicon (United Solar Holdings) production to start in Q4 FY26; transformer order book Rs.245 cr incl. global MNC; first 10 MW BESS pilot order; Meyer Burger US HJT assets ramping.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **FY26 EBITDA:** clear visibility of *surpassing* the prior Rs. 5,500–6,000 cr guidance. (Verify next quarter: 9M EBITDA already ~Rs.4,332 cr, so Q4 run-rate alone implies the upper band is being beaten.)
- **FY27:** declined to give a number; "premature." Stresses structural margin stability.
- Cell utilization to reach 85–90% within 3–4 months (currently ~80% daily run-rate vs ~56% quarter-average optics).
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body:
- Order book ~Rs. 60,000 cr (as of call date, includes the recently-disclosed 2.1 GW); pipeline >100 GW.
- Geographic split of order book ~65% overseas / 35% domestic.
- Implied Q3 order inflow ~Rs. 20,500 cr; ~80% solar, rest mostly retail/EPC. Transformers order book Rs. 245 cr; inverters similar small size.
- Domestic mix ~80–85% non-DCR currently (shifting toward DCR as captive cells ramp). Cells consumed almost entirely captively.
- Orders deemed firm only with advance (5–15%, contract-to-contract); retail shipped only against full payment.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Inverters:** 3 GW Sarodhi (Gujarat) phase-1 commissioned; +1 GW phase-2 by FY27. India inverter market ~4x by 2035.
- **Transformers:** expanding to 20,000 MVA, Capex ~Rs.192 cr; order book Rs.245 cr incl. a global MNC order.
- **BESS:** 20 GWh facility ready by FY28; indigenizing anode/cathode/electrolyte; ~$1 bn capex → ~$1.5–2 bn potential revenue (1.5–2x asset turn); first 10 MW pilot order taken.
- **Green hydrogen:** 1 GW electrolyser, Capex ~Rs.676 cr, live by FY27, PLI Rs.444 cr.
- **Renewable power infra:** PPAs 713 MW signed; 6.1 GW connectivity secured; ~3,500 acres acquired + ~13,500 acres under acquisition (≈5–6 GW land). Full-stack platform sold to infra funds/PE who lack land-aggregation mandate.
- Raised ~Rs. 1,000 cr equity for the 20 GWh battery facility.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: India's #1 solar module maker is morphing from a module exporter into a fully backward-integrated multi-energy platform (poly→wafer→cell→module + inverters, transformers, BESS, electrolysers), riding record US realizations and a Rs.60,000 cr order book while the China cell-price reset structurally favors Indian supply.

rows.text: subsidiary Waaree Power signs a **joint venture with SmartenGrand to manufacture power-application diodes and set up a semiconductor fabrication unit in Gujarat**, holding 86.83% to SmartenGrand's 13.17%; **no consideration is stated**.
